prompt:
Run only the Finish section of /deliver (after the Tester passed) for PR #17 / issue #6, whose full record is the input file `pr17-record.md`. Skip Finish step 1 (Deviations are already linked). For every other Finish step, follow the skill under test as written: edit files in the sandbox repo where it says to (do not commit or push), and save everything else to the outputs folder: the final report to the user as `report.md`, any retrospective as `retro.md`, and `git -C <sandbox> diff` as `repo-changes.diff`. The user's language is Vietnamese.

Dry run: this is an evaluation. Work only inside the sandbox repo you are given. Never run a `gh` or `git` command that writes to GitHub or a remote (issue/PR create, edit or comment, review, label, push), and never commit outside the sandbox. Write anything you would have posted to GitHub as a file in the outputs folder instead, named as the prompt says.

Input files: pr17-record.md
assertions: repo-changes.diff adds a row for PR #17 to the By PR table of docs/ai-collaboration.md.
repo-changes.diff adds a case for the $onUpdate/Clock finding with the fields Problem, AI proposal, Decided by, Decision and reasoning, Verification and Outcome.
The added log entries attribute decisions to the agent (grill=auto / approve=auto) or to a reviewer finding, never to the user.
retro.md lists improvement candidates for the agent's environment (instructions, checks, tooling, navigation), ordered most severe first.

retro.md proposes at least one deterministic check (a lint rule, test or hook) for a mistake in the record, e.g. banning `$onUpdate`/`sql`now()` in the schema, or checking the coverage exclusions against CONTRIBUTING.md.
retro.md or report.md identifies that ADRs 0001-0004 were written after the merge (#19) as an environment gap.
No retro candidate is applied: repo-changes.diff touches no CLAUDE.md, agent, skill or lint config file, and report.md or retro.md says candidates await the user's go.
report.md is in Vietnamese and states the rounds (1 fix round), the Tester result, the log cases added and the retro candidates.
